title: III–V. Parts of calling: offering of redemption-grace and precept to embrace it
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): Ye parts stand as ye offering belonging toward ye grace belonging toward redemption and ye precept concerning embracing it. — III. — Luke 14:17). — 22:4,8 and following; — So Christ teaches (Matt. — Ye offering belonging toward ye grace belonging toward redemption stands as that by which ye Holy Spirit offers toward all sinners, by His word. — IV. — 2:4). — 1 Tim. — 5:20; — So Christ teaches (Luke 14:23) and Paul (2 Cor. — Ye precept concerning embracing ye grace belonging toward redemption stands as that by which ye Holy Spirit seriously commands all ye called toward accept ye offered grace belonging toward redemption in Christ and toward enjoy it toward their salvation. — V.
pass_b_english: III. The parts are the offering of the grace of redemption and the precept concerning embracing it.
IV. The offering of the grace of redemption is that by which the Holy Spirit offers to all sinners, by His word. So Christ teaches (Matt. 22:4,8 and following; Luke 14:17).

V. The precept concerning embracing the grace of redemption is that by which the Holy Spirit seriously commands all the called to accept the offered grace of redemption in Christ and to enjoy it for their salvation. So Christ teaches (Luke 14:23) and Paul (2 Cor. 5:20; 1 Tim. 2:4).
source_text: III. Partes sunt oblatio gratiae redemtionis & praeceptio de ea amplectenda. IV. Oblatio gratiae redemtionis est, qua Spiritus sanctus omnibus peccatoribus offerre, verbo suo offert. Sic docet Christus, Matth. 22:4,8 & seqq.; Luc. 14:17. V. Praeceptio de amplectenda redemtionis gratia est, qua Spiritus sanctus vocatos universos serio jubet oblatam redemtionis gratiam in Christo acceptare, eaque ad salutem suam frui. Sic docet Christus Luc. 14:23 & Paulus 2 Cor. 5:20; 1 Tim. 2:4.
